DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis.

The clinical picture of mechanical pain in the first metatarsophalangeal joint, hips, and knees that worsens with activity and improves with rest, combined with your age, is classic for osteoarthritis. The absence of prolonged morning stiffness or inflammatory markers further supports this non-inflammatory diagnosis.
